newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan 8 coffee auction 120,100 bags - bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan 8 coffee auction 120,100 bags - bank.

text.p: The Brazilian government will auction 120,100 60-kg bags of coffee stocks in its next monthly sale on January 8, said an official from Banco do Brasil which is to hold the electronic sale.
Earlier an official from the National Coffee Department had said that the auction would be for 116,100 bags.

However documents sent to the Banco do Brasil are for the auction of 54,000 bags from Parana state, 41,751 bags from Sao Paulo state and 24,349 bags from Minas Gerais, the Banco do Brasil official said.
The coffee will be from the 1986/87 and the 1987/88 harvests, he added.
The sale, scheduled to take place at 1400 local/1600 GMT, will be the largest in a series of monthly auctions throughout the crop year (July/June).
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
